steps.name: Bust/Chest size
steps.description: Measures the circumference around the fullest part of the chest or bust, essential for determining proper garment fit across various clothing styles.

steps.name: Lumber/Wood thickness
steps.description: Indicates the depth measurement of building materials, determining structural properties and construction applications.

steps.name: Pin/Rod diameter
steps.description: Specifies the thickness of cylindrical fasteners or supports, determining strength and appropriate applications.

steps.name: Pin/Rod length
steps.description: Indicates the measurement from end to end of cylindrical components, determining reach and application suitability.

steps.name: Bluetooth version
steps.description: Specifies the supported Bluetooth specification level, which affects compatibility, range and power consumption.

steps.name: Maximum number of expansion microphones supported
steps.description: States how many external expansion microphones can be connected to the base unit to enlarge the audio pickup area.

steps.name: Maximum SIP accounts supported
steps.description: Specifies the highest number of separate SIP accounts/lines the conference phone can register and handle simultaneously.

steps.name: Microphone pickup range
steps.description: Indicates the maximum radial distance from which the built-in microphones can clearly capture speech.

steps.name: Number of built-in microphones
steps.description: States the count of microphones integrated into the conference phone unit.

steps.name: Recommended participant capacity
steps.description: Approximate maximum number of people the device can support effectively in one room.

steps.name: Number of handsets included
steps.description: States the total number of handsets packaged with the product (e.g., base corded handset plus additional units).

steps.name: Phonebook capacity
steps.description: Specifies the maximum number of contacts the phone’s internal directory or speed-dial memory can store.

steps.name: Number of programmable keys
steps.description: Indicates the total count of dedicated function or memory keys that can be custom-programmed (e.g., BLF, speed dial, feature keys).

steps.name: Ringer loudness
steps.description: Indicates the maximum audible loudness of the phone’s ringer, measured in decibels (dB). Useful for seniors or noisy environments.

steps.name: Maximum supported handsets
steps.description: Defines the total number of cordless handsets that can be registered to a single base unit, including handsets not supplied with the system.

steps.name: Number of telephone lines supported
steps.description: Defines how many separate phone lines (analog or SIP/VoIP) the cordless system can accommodate.

steps.name: Standby time
steps.description: Indicates the maximum duration the handset can remain powered on (idle) on a single charge.

steps.name: Talk time
steps.description: Specifies the maximum continuous voice call duration the cordless handset can provide on a single charge.

steps.name: Compatible phone brand
steps.description: Specifies the handset manufacturers that the accessory is designed to work with (e.g., Apple, Samsung, Google).

steps.name: Compatible phone model
steps.description: Indicates the exact phone model(s) the accessory fits or supports (e.g., iPhone 15 Pro Max, Galaxy S24 Ultra).

steps.name: Pack quantity
steps.description: Indicates the number of identical accessories or pieces included in one retail package.

steps.name: Light transmission
steps.description: Specifies the percentage of visible light that can pass through the lens protector or optical accessory, helping shoppers judge potential impact on image quality.

steps.name: Lens thread diameter
steps.description: Specifies the diameter of the lens or filter thread in millimeters, ensuring compatibility with mounts and filters.

steps.name: Minimum focus distance
steps.description: The closest distance at which the lens can achieve sharp focus, measured from the subject to the front of the lens.

steps.name: Number of lenses included
steps.description: Specifies how many individual lenses are provided in the product (useful for 2-in-1, 6-in-1, or multi-lens kits).

steps.name: Number of brightness levels
steps.description: Number of distinct brightness steps the lighting kit can output.

steps.name: Color rendering index (CRI)
steps.description: Indicates the lighting kit’s ability to accurately render colors compared with a natural light source, expressed on a 0–100 scale.

steps.name: Number of LEDs
steps.description: Total number of individual LEDs in the light source.

steps.name: Beam angle
steps.description: Specifies the beam angle of the light output, measured in degrees (°), indicating how wide the light spreads.

steps.name: Light color temperature range
steps.description: Minimum and maximum color temperature output of the light, expressed in Kelvin.

steps.name: Lighting kit components included
steps.description: Key accessories bundled with the lighting kit.

steps.name: Compatible device width
steps.description: Specifies the minimum and/or maximum clamping width that the phone holder can accommodate, ensuring the user’s device will fit.

steps.name: Number of card slots
steps.description: Indicates the number of integrated card slots/pockets in wallet-style phone cases.

steps.name: Drop protection height
steps.description: Specifies the certified maximum drop height from which the case can protect the phone without damage.

steps.name: Franchise or character
steps.description: Licensed franchise, mascot, or character depicted by the charm or strap.

steps.name: Activation window
steps.description: Number of days after purchase within which the SIM/eSIM must be activated before it expires.

steps.name: Mobile data allowance
steps.description: Indicates the high-speed data volume included in the plan, expressed in gigabytes.

steps.name: Mobile network operator
steps.description: Lists the carrier or mobile network that issues or underlies the prepaid card or SIM, such as AT&T, Vodafone, Docomo, or Telstra.

steps.name: Post-allowance data speed
steps.description: Specifies the connection speed that applies after the included high-speed data allowance is consumed (throttled speed).

steps.name: Prepaid balance amount
steps.description: Specifies the monetary credit value pre-loaded on the card or SIM (currency defined separately by the Currency attribute).

steps.name: SMS allowance
steps.description: Specifies the number of SMS messages (texts) included in the prepaid plan before additional charges apply.

steps.name: International call allowance
steps.description: Specifies the number of international voice minutes bundled with the prepaid product. Use 0 for unlimited minutes.

steps.name: Validity period
steps.description: Indicates the number of days the credit or package remains active once activated.

steps.name: Voice call allowance
steps.description: Indicates the total number of domestic or in-network voice minutes bundled with the prepaid product. Enter 0 or leave blank for unlimited or not applicable plans.

steps.name: Number of countries covered
steps.description: States how many individual countries are supported by the SIM’s included plan without additional roaming fees.

steps.name: Battery health
steps.description: Remaining battery health level for used or refurbished phones, expressed as a percentage (0–100 %).

steps.name: Release year
steps.description: Indicates the calendar year the phone model was originally launched.

steps.name: Fast charging technology
steps.description: Identifies the proprietary or standard fast-charging protocols supported by the phone.

steps.name: Front camera resolution
steps.description: Maximum resolution of the front-facing (selfie) camera, measured in megapixels (MP).

steps.name: Maximum expandable storage capacity
steps.description: Specifies the highest-capacity memory card the phone supports.

steps.name: Network carrier compatibility
steps.description: Lists specific wireless carriers supported out of the box or whether the phone is factory unlocked.

steps.name: Operating system version
steps.description: Specifies the exact OS version the device ships with (e.g., iOS 17, Android 14, HarmonyOS 4).

steps.name: Number of rear cameras
steps.description: The number of separate rear-facing camera modules on the device.

steps.name: Rear camera resolution
steps.description: Maximum resolution of the primary (rear) camera module, measured in megapixels (MP).

steps.name: Warranty period
steps.description: Specifies the length of the warranty provided with the phone.

steps.name: Maximum wired charging power
steps.description: Maximum supported wired charging wattage for the device.

steps.name: Wireless charging power
steps.description: States the maximum wattage the device can accept when charging wirelessly.

steps.name: Military durability standard compliance
steps.description: Indicates compliance with formal durability standards such as MIL-STD-810 or IK impact ratings beyond IP water/dust resistance.

steps.name: Specific absorption rate (SAR)
steps.description: Indicates the radio-frequency energy absorbed by the body when using the phone, expressed in W/kg.

steps.name: Blocked number capacity
steps.description: Specifies the maximum quantity of telephone numbers a call-blocking device can store and reject.

steps.name: Number of conductors
steps.description: States the number of individual internal conductors or pairs in a telephone cable (e.g., 2, 4, 6), helping users verify line capacity.

steps.name: Number of telephone ports
steps.description: Indicates the total number of RJ-style phone jacks or ports available on the accessory (e.g., on a splitter, adapter, or call-blocker), helping shoppers confirm capacity for their phone lines.

steps.name: Phone card reference number
steps.description: Unique alphanumeric catalogue or issue code printed on the card (e.g., SP-0277, PI-024M).

steps.name: Phone card series name
steps.description: Identifies the official set, campaign, or artwork series that the phone card belongs to, enabling collectors to group cards released together (e.g., “Floresta Tropical”, “Invenções”).

steps.name: Print run quantity
steps.description: Total number of cards produced in the print run.

steps.name: Subnational region of issue
steps.description: State, province, or city where the phone card was issued (e.g., São Paulo, London).

steps.name: Year of issue
steps.description: Calendar year the phone card was first released or printed.
